dataList.name:
无休止的哀嚎
 Ceaseless Wailing
dataList.desc: 遭遇战开始：进入恐慌状态 若本单位处于恐慌状态，施加以下效果： - 所有攻击均以布布为目标 - 使用技能时，若布布为主要目标，则获得拼点威力与基础威力 - 战斗开始：将所有硬币转化为[SuperCoin] Encounter Start: Enter Panic state If this unit is in Panic state, apply the following effects: - All Attacks target Pwie - On Skill Use, if Pwie is the main target, gain Clash Power and Base Power - Combat Start: Convert all Coins into [SuperCoin]s
dataList.flavor:
那远古之物的孩子们，已经不复存在了。
 The children of the thing of eld are no more.

dataList.name:
缠结的黑线
 Tangled Black Thread
dataList.desc: 本单位技能、士气低落与恐慌的效果，会对敌人施加[TangleBlackYarn] ※ [TangleBlackYarn]可以通过使用防御技能或本单位的特定技能来减少 受到攻击时，触发以下效果： - 获得1层[SickBlackYarn] - 若命中本单位的技能是斩击技能，额外获得1层[SickBlackYarn] - 若命中本单位的技能攻击加权值达到5以上，则下回合获得[HeavyBlackYarn]（每回合1次） The effects of this unit's Skills, Low Morale, and Panic inflict [TangleBlackYarn] on the enemy ※ [TangleBlackYarn] can be reduced either by using Defense Skills or via certain Skills of this unit When hit, activate the following effects: - Gain 1 [SickBlackYarn] - If the Skill that hit this unit is a Slash Skill, gain 1 additional [SickBlackYarn] - If the Skill that hit this unit has 5+ Atk Weight, gain [HeavyBlackYarn] next turn (once per turn)
dataList.flavor:
缠绕在它躯体上的这些黑线，原本并不存在。全凭一份运气，在上个时代让位给下个时代之际，那些丝线便缠上了这远古之物的躯体。裹着丝线，它活过了百货商场时代。如今，那些黑线开始渐渐松开了。
 The black thread wound around its body was not there before. By sheer fortune, when the previous age gave way to the next, those threads coiled around the body of the thing of eld. Wrapped in thread, it survived into the Age of the Department Store. Now, those black threads begin to come undone.

dataList.name:
回归远古之水
 Into the Waters of Eld
dataList.desc: 若某个部位陷入混乱，则移除其他部位1层混乱区间并结束回合；随后，所有部位下回合获得[HideBlackYarn] 若[HideBlackYarn]因受到攻击而失效， - 获得10层[SickBlackYarn] - 若[SickBlackYarn]获得量超过其上限，则本回合与下回合获得3层易损 回合结束：若[HideBlackYarn]已失效， - 获得（7-剩余威力）层[SickBlackYarn] - 下回合获得1层[AngryBlackYarn] If a Part becomes Staggered, remove 1 Stagger Threshold from other Parts and end the turn; then, all Parts gain [HideBlackYarn] next turn If [HideBlackYarn] expired due to being hit, - Gain 10 [SickBlackYarn] - If [SickBlackYarn] was gained beyond its max cap, gain 3 Fragile this turn and next turn Turn End: If [HideBlackYarn] expired, - Gain (7 - remaining Potency) [SickBlackYarn] - Gain 1 [AngryBlackYarn] next turn
dataList.flavor:
回归那久远时代大海的怀抱，昔日它曾在那里自由自在地畅游。
 Into the embrace of the sea from a bygone age, where once it swam as naturally and freely as could be.

dataList.name:
挥之不去的潮湿
 Lingering Dampness
dataList.desc:
受到[Combustion]、[Laceration]、[Vibration]、[Burst]与[Sinking]的体力与精神力伤害减少；[Vibration]造成的混乱区间前移量-50%

本单位的恐慌类型不会因施加改变恐慌类型的效果而改变
回合结束：若本单位处于恐慌状态，则精神力归零
 Take less HP and SP damage from [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], and [Sinking]; -50% to Stagger Threshold raised by [Vibration]

This unit's Panic Type does not change when inflicted with an effect that changes Panic Types
Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, SP returns to 0
dataList.flavor:
水族箱西西弗早已不复存在，但这具躯体仍残留着那段岁月里的一丝水汽——尚未化为丝线的湿意。
 Aquarium Sisyphe is gone, yet this body still retains a faint trace of the water from those days—moisture that has not yet turned to thread.

dataList.name:
陶土塑成的玩偶
 A Doll Molded from Clay
dataList.desc:
遭遇战开始：体力回复至上限

 Encounter Start: Heal to max HP

The Core and the Part do not take damage from [Combustion] and [Laceration]
dataList.flavor:
那如瓷器般的肌肤，其实来自陶土。
 That porcelain-like skin came from clay.

dataList.name:
不凋花
 Unwithering Flower
dataList.desc: 战斗开始：获得1层[AlriunePetal] 若本单位陷入混乱， - 下回合获得2层[Vulnerable] - 使罪人与援护单位回复20点精神力 - 回合开始：若本单位从混乱中恢复，则将[AlriunePetal]重置为1 回合开始：若没有敌人持有[FlowerLaurelWreath]，则装备“芬芳的月桂花环”技能 - 若本单位本回合装备了“怀揣归于尘土的希望……”，则下回合装备上述技能 受到未持有[FlowerLaurelWreath]的敌人所用技能造成的伤害-50% 受到持有[FlowerLaurelWreath]的敌人造成的伤害+150% Combat Start: Gain 1 [AlriunePetal] If this unit becomes Staggered, - Gain 2 [Vulnerable] next turn - Heal 20 SP on Sinners and Assist Units - Turn Start: If this unit recovered from Stagger, reset [AlriunePetal] to 1 Turn Start: If no enemies have [FlowerLaurelWreath], equip the "Fragrant Laurel Wreath" Skill - Equip the said Skill next turn if this unit equipped "Bearing the hope to return to dust..." this turn Take -50% damage from Skills used by enemies that do not have [FlowerLaurelWreath] Take +150% damage from enemies that have [FlowerLaurelWreath]
dataList.flavor:
花朵会凋谢。而后它们又会再次绽放。
 Flowers wilt. Then they bloom again.

dataList.name:
春之降临

dataList.desc: 对陷入混乱的敌人造成20点精神力伤害 回合开始：若存在处于恐慌或侵蚀状态的目标，则对该目标使用“……它将带着一切求生的渴望，一同归于坟墓”（每回合最多2次，优先选择速度最慢的敌人，按速度升序，不包括援护单位） 若上述技能击杀了目标，则下回合召唤1只“从大地中显现之物” - 场上存在4只“从大地中显现之物”时，此效果不会触发 Deal 20 SP damage to Staggered enemies Turn Start: If there is a target in Panic or in Corrosion, use "... It shall go back to the grave with all that desires to live" on the said target (max 2 times per turn, prioritizes the slowest enemies in ascending order of Speed, excluding Assist Units) If the said Skill killed the target, summon 1 "One Who Emerged from the Earth" next turn - This effect does not activate when there are 4 "One Who Emerged from the Earth" on the field
dataList.flavor:
待到春天到来，它便会绽放。
 When spring comes, it shall bloom.

dataList.name:
来自大地
 From the Earth
dataList.desc: 本单位不会受到[Combustion]与[Laceration]造成的伤害 受[Vibration]影响的混乱区间前移量+100% 本单位陷入混乱时即被击败 This unit does not take damage from [Combustion] and [Laceration] +100% to Stagger Threshold raised by [Vibration] This unit is defeated when Staggered
dataList.flavor:
归于大地。
 Back to the earth.

若目标速度低于本单位，则获得拼点威力
 If target's Speed is slower than this unit's, gain Clash Power
dataList.flavor:
大姐能达到每分钟10000针。
 Big Sis can reach 10,000 SPM.

钉死的针脚

dataList.desc:

 Deal +40% damage to Staggered or immobilized targets
dataList.flavor:
没有什么比缝一件不能动的东西更简单的了。
 Nothing is easier than stitching something that cannot move.

dataList.name:

对持有[ThreadDye]的目标施加以下效果：

对持有[Inactible]的技能目标不施加[ThreadDye]

Does not inflict [ThreadDye] on Skill targets that have [Inactible]
dataList.flavor:
你负责缝布料，大姐。我来帮你染色。
 You stitch the fabric, Big Sis. I'll dye with you.

dataList.name:
针数调节器调整

遭遇战开始：体力回复至上限并回复45点精神力

 Encounter Start: Heal max HP and 45 SP

Gain 1 [ChargeKhaki] for every 10 cumulative [ChargeKhaki] Count this unit consumed in this Encounter

dataList.name:
改衣
 Alteration
dataList.desc: 回合开始：对上回合对本单位造成最多伤害的罪人施加1层[TailoringTarget]，并使用“制版”技能 - 若该持有[TailoringTarget]的罪人持有9层[ScissorsMark]，则改为触发“链式锁边”而非“制版” 每当本单位受到罪人攻击， - 对该罪人施加1层[ScissorsMark]（每名罪人每回合最多5层） - 获得+1层[ChargeKhaki]（每名罪人每回合最多5层） 每当本单位受到持有[TailoringTarget]的罪人攻击，获得3层[ResultEnhancement]（每回合最多9层） Turn Start: Inflict 1 [TailoringTarget] on the Sinner that dealt the most damage to this unit last turn and use the "Patterning" Skill - If the [TailoringTarget] Sinner has 9 [ScissorsMark], activate "Patterning" as "Surfile à la Chaîne" instead Every time this unit is hit by a Sinner, - Inflict 1 [ScissorsMark] on the said Sinner (max 5 per turn per Sinner) - Gain +1 [ChargeKhaki] Count (max 5 per turn per Sinner) Gain 3 [ResultEnhancement] every time this unit is hit by a Sinner that has [TailoringTarget] (max 9 per turn)
dataList.flavor:
人们说，一件衣服唯有经过改衣，才算真正完成。除非量身定制，否则总要经过调整，才能合身。

这并非只适用于衣物。任何从外界吸纳而来的东西，都必须先经过改造以适应自身，才能被穿上、被容纳、被裁合于心。
 They say a garment is only truly finished through alteration. Unless it was made to measure, it has to be adjusted until it fits the wearer.

And that is not true of clothing alone. Whatever is taken in from the outside must first be altered to suit oneself before it can be worn, lived in, and made to fit the heart.

dataList.name:
裁剪
 Tailoring
dataList.desc: 在遭遇战开始时，或在本单位从混乱中恢复的回合开始时，获得30层[FinishedFabric] 施加[PanicChangeLock]效果 回合结束：若本单位处于恐慌状态，则将精神力变为30 回合开始： - 获得等同于([FinishedFabric]层数)%体力的护盾（最多30%） - 回复等同于[FinishedFabric]层数的精神力 At Encounter Start or at the start of the turn this unit recovered from Stagger, gain 30 [FinishedFabric] Apply the [PanicChangeLock] effect Turn End: If this unit is in Panic, change SP to 30 Turn Start: - Gain Shield equal to ([FinishedFabric] Stack)% HP (max 30%) - Heal SP equal to [FinishedFabric] Stack
dataList.flavor:
裁剪，就是把布料塑造成版型的过程。裁剪赋予衣物形态，而改衣则让它变得可穿。

对布料而言，裁剪本身也是一种改造。一旦被裁开，布料便会呈现出反映自身特性的形状，成为裁剪者所构想的那件衣物。
 Cutting means shaping fabric to a pattern. Cutting gives a garment its form, while alteration makes it wearable.

To fabric, then, cutting itself is a form of alteration. Once cut, the fabric takes on a shape that reflects its own properties, becoming the garment the cutter intended.

dataList.name:
永不停歇的剪刀
 Scissors That Do Not Rest
dataList.desc: 每当改衣师安妮特受到罪人攻击，混乱区间提升等同于0.8%体力的数值 若本单位陷入混乱，则失去全部护盾、[FinishedFabric]与[LargeTailoringShears]；随后获得3层[Vulnerable] 回合开始：体力降至60%或以下时， - 每损失20%体力，获得1层[ResultEnhancement]与1层[SlashDamageUp]（各自最多3层） - 将“修边”最后一枚硬币与“裁剪”第2枚硬币转化为[SuperCoin] Every time Annette the Alterationist is hit by a Sinner, raise Stagger Threshold equal to 0.8% HP If this unit is Staggered, lose all Shield, [FinishedFabric], and [LargeTailoringShears]; then, gain 3 [Vulnerable] Turn Start: At 60% or less HP, - Gain 1 [ResultEnhancement] and 1 [SlashDamageUp] for every 20% missing HP (max 3 respectively) - Convert the final Coin of "Trimming" and Coin 2 of "Cutting" to [SuperCoin]
dataList.flavor:
一具其价值全由改衣之工塑造的躯体，永不停歇地裁剪下去，被永远改造、永远裁制的冲动所驱使。

即便这躯体正在分崩离析，她也无法让自己停下改衣与裁剪。她生来就是为了把东西剪掉，却剪不掉束缚自己的枷锁。
 A body whose very worth was shaped by the work of alteration goes on cutting without end, driven to alter and tailor forever.

Even as the body breaks apart, she cannot bring herself to stop altering and cutting. She is made to cut things away, yet cannot cut herself free.

他们随着百货商场时代所塑造的价值观漂流，被那份惯性推着向前；而这惯性愈发强大，他们便愈发无法停止漂流。
 They drift along the values shaped by the Age of the Department Store, swept onward by their inertia; and the stronger that inertia grows, the less able they are to stop drifting.

各自坚守岗位，忠实履行被托付的职责。他们合在一起，构成一个阵型，而这个阵型便成为保存整体的形象。各就其位，忠于所托。

dataList.desc: 回合开始：场上鞣制囚徒数量为2名或以下时，获得额外技能栏 回合结束：场上每有1名鞣制囚徒，下回合获得1层[AttackDmgUp] Turn Start: When there are 2 or fewer Tanned Prisoners on the field, gain additional Slot Turn End: Gain 1 [AttackDmgUp] next turn for every Tanned Prisoner on the field
dataList.flavor:
违规者的皮被剥下，粘附其上的罪孽被彻底刮净，只留下皮革可供收割。
 The transgressor's hide is torn away, and the sin clinging to it is scraped clean, leaving only the hide to be harvested.

dataList.flavor:

dataList.name:
原罪制革工坊：全力运转
 Tannery of the Original Sin: Full Operation
dataList.desc:
核心体力低于50%时，结束回合并进入新的模式；包括本单位在内的所有友方，在本场遭遇战剩余时间内获得[RestrictFailed]
 At less than 50% Core HP, end the turn and enter a new pattern; all allies, including this unit, gain [RestrictFailed] for the rest of this Encounter
dataList.flavor:
需求早已爆表，而生皮却愈发难得。原罪之人的皮革曾是连看都没人愿意多看一眼的东西。直到某一季，一切都变了：需求暴涨，价格飙升，曾经被当作边角料贱卖甚至直接丢弃的东西，如今成了人人觊觎的材料。

如今，就连表面的瑕疵，也被包装成个性，当作卖点出售。
 Demand has gone through the roof, while raw hides have only grown harder to come by. The hide of the original sinners was once the sort nobody would so much as glance at. Then one season changed everything: demand surged, prices soared, and what used to be sold for scraps or simply thrown away became coveted material.

Now even the blemishes on its surface are dressed up as character and sold as part of the appeal.

dataList.flavor:

 What separates a slab of meat from hide is a strict regime of tanning, governed by exacting rules.

堵上耳朵也能听见的投诉
 Unending, Unavoidable Stream of Customer Complaints
dataList.desc:
每到3的倍数回合，会听见茧的悲鸣
进入第2阶段后，茧的悲鸣每回合持续

在听见茧的悲鸣的回合，自身免疫无法行动状态

若自身的体力降至混乱阈值之下，则下回合对自身施加2层[Vulnerable]

Upon entering Phase 2, "Cry of the Cocoon" continues to be heard every turn

This unit cannot be immobilized in the turn "Cry of the Cocoon" is heard

If this unit's HP is brought past its Stagger Threshold, gain 2 [Vulnerable] next turn
dataList.flavor:
从茧里传来了声音。
“80支2股以下不算是面料。” “纽扣眼为什么不是横的？”
“是旧式织机织出来的天竺布吗？” “布边的颜色为什么不是红色？”
“这个没做防缩水工艺呢。” “Super150以下的都是廉价面料吧。”
“你说Super等级只代表线的粗细？直径和支数都不一样，怎么连这个都不知道。”
“肯定会用Union Special给下摆做处理吧？” “这个是硬化过的吗？啊，还是说是布边？”
“仔细看去，针脚太均匀了，是用了机器吧？” “不是纯手工缝制就算不上定做。”
“啊，这不是米兰式扣眼啊。” “支数得超过200才能叫衬衫面料吧。”
“啊，从外面能看见缝线呢。” “能看到两列缝线呢。淘汰。”
“缝份怎么处理成这样。” “得超过3股才行。”
 Voices seep from the cocoon.

"Anything under 80-count two-ply? Not even fabric!"
"Why aren't the buttonholes horizontal?"
"Jersey knit on machine? Really?"
"Why isn't the selvage red?"
"This hasn't even been shrink-proofed."
"Anything below Super 150 is cheap cloth, obviously."
"You think the Super scale is just yarn thickness? Diameter and yarn count aren't even the same thing. Don't you know that?"
"You're finishing the hem with a Union Special, right? Of course you are!"
"Is this Rigid? ... Oh. Selvage?"
"Wait... the stitch-per-inch count is way too even. You used a machine, didn't you?"
"It's not bespoke if it's not hand-stitched."
"... That's not even a Milanese buttonhole."
"Shirting needs to be over 200-count."
"Ugh, I can see the stitching on the outside."
"There, I can see two rows of stitching there. Rejected."
"What's with this seam finish?"
"Three-ply, minimum."
